definitions.gloss: growing wild; growing naturally; indigenous growth
definitions.explanation: Plants growing naturally without human cultivation. Used to describe wild flora in their native habitat.

examples.japanese: この{花|はな}は{山|やま}に{自生|じせい}している。
examples.english: This flower grows wild in the mountains.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}に{自生|じせい}する{植物|しょくぶつ}を{調|しら}べている。
examples.english: I'm researching plants that grow naturally in Japan.

examples.japanese: {野生|やせい}のわさびが{渓流|けいりゅう}のそばに{自生|じせい}しているのを{見|み}つけた。
examples.english: I found wild wasabi growing naturally by the mountain stream.

notes: Distinguished from {栽培|さいばい} (cultivation) and {植林|しょくりん} (afforestation). The pattern {自生|じせい}する is intransitive. {自生|じせい}{地|ち} (natural habitat/growing area) is a common compound. Not to be confused with the homophone {自制|じせい} (self-control).
